about: module work's mutants (SEMWS WS0, WS1, WS5a-early, WG0); each is judged by the module's tests and laws (scripts/examples -modules work) or by the cases of the binary that binds it (scripts/examples work), not by a compiler test. The law, test or case that kills each is named in its rule.

mutants.name: ws0-copy-picked-silently
mutants.rule: A plain copy is never picked silently: with no sharing Cloner and no -copy, new is CopyRefused and registers nothing (memory's ToolAgreesWithTheReference, CopyRefusedSaysTheBytes).

mutants.name: ws0-write-into-shared-block
mutants.rule: A clone shares no writable block after a write (the model's hard link: a write into a block another tree holds): memory's WritesStayPrivate, CloneOfCloneEqualsBase.

mutants.name: ws0-reflink-hard-links
mutants.rule: A host clone shares no writable block after a write (the provider returns a hard link): the new case's postcreate hook writes the clone's a.txt and prints the base's, which must be unchanged.

mutants.name: ws0-gc-shares-a-home
mutants.rule: gc reads only its own base's registry and trash: one home for every base beside one folder makes the bases share a registry and a trash (the gc, list and rm cases, which keep two bases' folders apart).

mutants.name: ws0-rm-unkept-work
mutants.rule: rm refuses a workspace whose work is not in its parent unless -abandon: memory's ToolAgreesWithTheReference (an edit, then rm), the rm-dirty case.

mutants.name: ws0-refused-clone-stays-registered
mutants.to:
case CopyRefused as e:
		return e
mutants.rule: A new that does not clone leaves no registered workspace with no tree: memory's ToolAgreesWithTheReference, CopyRefusedSaysTheBytes.

mutants.name: ws0-gc-keeps-cut-clones
mutants.rule: A crash between the reservation and the clone leaves Creating, and gc removes its record and its tree once its maker is gone: memory's ToolAgreesWithTheReference (CrashOp, GcOp), StoppedWriterIsFinished.

mutants.name: ws0-usage-shared-as-exclusive
mutants.rule: Usage reports shared bytes as shared, not exclusive: memory's UsageSplitsTheBlocks and work.Cloner.FreshCloneSharesItsBlocks.

mutants.name: ws0-leave-out-ignored
mutants.rule: new leaves out the leave_out folders of work.toml: the new case's postcreate hook checks that tmp is not in the clone.

mutants.name: ws0-torn-line-kept
mutants.rule: A journal line a crash cut short is no record: journal's TornWriteIsDropped, the list case.

mutants.name: ws0-landing-commits-to-active
mutants.rule: A committed land lands the workspace: Lifecycle.SomeWorkspaceLands, OnlyActiveLands.

mutants.name: ws0-landed-cannot-be-removed
mutants.rule: Every workspace can be removed: Lifecycle.EveryWorkspaceCanBeRemoved, LandedIsFinal.

mutants.name: ws0-git-always-clean
mutants.rule: git's Clean sees an untracked file: the rm-dirty case is NotHeld.

mutants.name: ws0-json-failure-empty-message
mutants.rule: With --json a failure is its JSON on standard output, and standard error says so, not a bare "ergo work: " line (an os.Exit always writes its Message and a line feed): the json-noinit case.

mutants.name: ws1-snapshot-misses-untracked
mutants.rule: A snapshot holds the untracked files (the plan's mutant): memory's SnapshotIsTheFiles.

mutants.name: ws1-git-snapshot-misses-untracked
mutants.rule: git's snapshot holds the untracked files: the ready case's snapshot tree holds note.txt.

mutants.name: ws1-snapshot-moves-index
mutants.rule: A snapshot changes no index (the plan's mutant): Vcs.SnapshotChangesNoBranch on memory's fixture, whose untracked file a staging snapshot would make clean.

mutants.name: ws1-ready-pushes-origin
mutants.from: let mut args = []string{"push", "--atomic", "--porcelain", try other(root, parent)}
mutants.rule: ready hands to the parent, never to origin (the plan's mutant): the ready case, whose origin is another repository.

mutants.name: ws1-on-records-base
mutants.from: Workspace{Name: m.Name, Id: m.Id, Path: m.Path, Parent: m.Parent, Branch: m.Branch, Cloner: m.Cloner,
mutants.to: Workspace{Name: m.Name, Id: m.Id, Path: m.Path, Parent: t.base, Branch: m.Branch, Cloner: m.Cloner,
mutants.rule: new -on records the workspace it clones as the parent, not the base (the plan's mutant): memory's StackRecordsItsParent (and ToolAgreesWithTheReference's OnOp, when a seed reaches one).

mutants.name: ws1-from-ignored
mutants.rule: new -from starts the branch at the revision: the new-from case.

mutants.name: ws1-cas-not-atomic
mutants.rule: A set from a stale read is Moved: Vcs.CompareAndSetIsAtomic on memory.

mutants.name: ws1-sync-merges-own-branch
mutants.rule: sync merges the parent's branch: memory's ParityWithLaneRift (the lane merges main), the sync case.

mutants.name: ws1-start-no-guard
mutants.rule: new stops pushes to origin as lane-rift.sh does: the new-from case prints the push URL.

mutants.name: ws1-kept-ignores-ready
mutants.rule: rm takes a workspace whose snapshot ready handed and that has not changed since, uncommitted work and all: the rm-ready case (the model property draws an edit, a ready and an rm of one name too seldom to kill it).

mutants.name: ws1-snapshot-keeps-ignored
mutants.rule: A snapshot leaves out ignored files: memory's SnapshotIsTheFiles.

mutants.name: ws1-env-unreplaced
mutants.rule: env names the workspace's folder: the env case.

mutants.name: ws1-journal-drops-base
mutants.rule: The journal keeps a record's base and latest snapshot: journal's ReplayIsTheMemoryRegistry.

mutants.name: ws5e-removal-beats-change
mutants.from: if equal(theirs, base, same) || equal(ours, theirs, same) {
mutants.to: if equal(theirs, base, same) || equal(ours, theirs, same) || theirs == None {
mutants.rule: A removal against a change is a conflict, never a removal (the plan's mutant): classes' RowsByUnitsAreTheReference.

mutants.name: ws5e-row-clash-taken
mutants.to:
} else {
				out = out.Append(Row{Key: r.Key, Raw: r.Raw})
mutants.rule: A row both sides changed apart conflicts; ours is not taken silently: classes' RowsByUnitsAreTheReference.

mutants.name: ws5e-their-row-dropped
mutants.from: out = rowInserted(out, after, Row{Key: r.Key, Raw: v.Value})
mutants.rule: A row only theirs added is in the merge: classes' RowsAreTheReference.

mutants.name: ws5e-measured-takes-theirs
mutants.rule: A number both sides measured apart is the lander's (ours): classes' MeasuredIsTheReference.

mutants.name: ws5e-measured-not-marked
mutants.rule: A file with a number both sides measured apart is marked to be measured again: classes' MeasuredIsTheReference.

mutants.name: ws5e-lines-keep-removed
mutants.rule: A line theirs removed is not in the merge: classes' LinesAreTheReference.

mutants.name: ws5e-text-merge-blind
mutants.rule: The line merge takes theirs' change where ours left the base: classes' TextIsDiff3.

mutants.name: ws5e-derived-merged
mutants.rule: A derived file is never merged by lines (the plan: regenerate, never merge): classes' DerivedIsNeverMerged.

mutants.name: ws5e-merge-file-writes-nothing
mutants.rule: merge-file leaves the merge in ours, the file Git keeps: memory's MergeFileWritesTheMerge.

mutants.name: ws5e-merge-file-conflict-clean
mutants.rule: A merge with conflicts ends with status 1, so Git keeps the file conflicted: the merge-clash case.

mutants.name: wg0-default-leaves-out-node-modules
mutants.rule: The default clone copies everything, installed packages included: CloneCarriesEverything and the new-carries case.

mutants.name: wg0-leave-out-keeps-the-last
mutants.rule: leave_out leaves out every folder it names, and only those: LeaveOutLeavesOnlyThose (two folders).

mutants.name: wg0-marker-in-the-tree
mutants.rule: The marker is in the clone's Git folder, never in its tree (git status shows nothing): the new-carries case.

mutants.name: wg0-new-writes-the-source
mutants.from: let marked = mark(t, m.Path, m.Id) catch {
mutants.to: let marked = mark(t, m.Parent, m.Id) catch {
mutants.rule: new writes nothing into its source: the new-carries case (the base's status).

mutants.name: wg0-hook-under-the-lock
mutants.rule: No hook runs while the registry's lock is held: NoHookUnderTheLock.

mutants.name: wg0-hook-for-an-unallowed-digest
mutants.from:
if !trusted(t, c) {
		let v Hooked = untrusted(c)
mutants.to:
if false {
		let v Hooked = untrusted(c)
mutants.rule: A config whose digest work trust has not allowed runs no hook: UnallowedConfigRunsNothing and the hooks-untrusted case.

mutants.name: wg0-install-for-an-unallowed-digest
mutants.rule: A config whose digest work trust has not allowed runs no install: UnallowedConfigRunsNothing.

mutants.name: wg0-deps-installs-when-equal
mutants.rule: deps starts no process when the lock's digest is the one installed: InstallOnlyWhenTheLockDiffers.

mutants.name: wg0-deps-forgets-the-digest
mutants.from: let done = Workspace{..w, Deps: digest, Token: "", Moving: ""}
mutants.rule: An install records the lock's digest, so the next deps of the same lock does nothing: InstallOnlyWhenTheLockDiffers.

mutants.name: wg0-init-leaves-the-index-stale
mutants.rule: init refreshes the base's index, so a clone starts with no stale stat: InitRefreshesTheIndex.

mutants.name: wg0-branch-by-checkout-at-head
mutants.rule: At the source's HEAD the branch is two ref writes and the index is not rewritten: the new-carries case (same-index).

mutants.name: wg0-memory-branch-by-checkout-at-head
mutants.rule: The reference Vcs makes a branch at the head with no index write: BranchAtHeadWritesNoIndex.

mutants.name: wg0-no-stat-settings
mutants.rule: A clone made file by file gets core.checkStat=minimal and core.trustctime=false: the new-carries case.

mutants.name: wg0-json-without-id
mutants.from: Created{Name: m.Name, Id: m.Id, Path: m.Path,
mutants.rule: new answers {path, id}: the new-carries case (the id equals the marker).

mutants.name: wg0-postcreate-in-the-parent
mutants.rule: postcreate runs in the new workspace: HooksRunInOrder.

mutants.name: wg0-hook-failure-runs-on
mutants.from:
case HookFailed as f:
			let v Hooked = f
			return v
mutants.to:
case HookFailed as f:
			let v Hooked = f
			let _ = v
mutants.rule: A failed hook command stops its hook and is new's answer: FailedPostcreateLeavesActive and FailedHookIsInCreated.

mutants.name: wg0-failed-postcreate-drops
mutants.rule: A failed postcreate leaves the workspace active and registered: FailedPostcreateLeavesActive.

mutants.name: wg0-hook-env-without-id
mutants.rule: A hook sees the workspace's id as WORK_ID: the new-carries case.

mutants.name: wg0-stat-dirty-counts-changes
mutants.rule: refresh and doctor count stale stats, not changed files: the refresh case.

mutants.name: wg0-memory-exit-is-success
mutants.rule: The reference Hooks fails "exit N" as sh does: Hooks.ExitIsAFailure.

mutants.name: wg0-journal-release-keeps-hold
mutants.rule: A release forgets the hold, so the same process holds the key again (new holds the mutation lock twice): the examples/work cases.

mutants.name: wg1-rm-ignores-expect
mutants.rule: rm -expect removes only the workspace of that id (the model's NoExpect): RemovingIsIdempotent, IdMismatchNamesBothIds.

mutants.name: wg1-rm-takes-the-subtree
mutants.rule: rm of a workspace with a child is HasDescendants (the model's SubtreeRemove): HasDescendantsNamesThePaths, SchedulesKeepTheInvariants.

mutants.name: wg1-reservation-is-no-child
mutants.from:
match w.State {
		case Trashed:
		case Creating, Active, Landing, Landed, Abandoned:
			out = out.Append(w.Path)
mutants.to:
match w.State {
		case Trashed, Creating:
		case Active, Landing, Landed, Abandoned:
			out = out.Append(w.Path)
mutants.rule: A reservation on a workspace counts as its child: SchedulesKeepTheInvariants (an rm of x between a new -on x's reservation and its activation).

mutants.name: wg1-mismatch-before-the-tomb
mutants.to: if here == "" && removedBefore(all, try t.registry.Tombs(), e.Value) {
mutants.rule: rm -expect of a removed id answers already even when a new workspace has the name: RemovingSparesTheReplacement.

mutants.name: wg1-purge-keeps-no-tomb
mutants.rule: gc keeps a tomb of each id it purges, so an rm -expect retry answers already: RemovingIsIdempotent, PurgingTouchesOneEntry.

mutants.name: wg1-gc-id-takes-all
mutants.rule: gc -id purges that entry only: PurgingTouchesOneEntry.

mutants.name: wg1-finish-skips-the-move
mutants.rule: The next mutation finishes an intent a stopped rm left: the folder moves to the trash its record names (the model's NoIntent): SchedulesKeepTheInvariants.

mutants.name: wg1-maker-always-gone
mutants.rule: gc and rm leave a reservation whose maker still copies: SchedulesKeepTheInvariants (a gc between a new's reservation and its activation).

mutants.name: wg1-copy-under-the-lock
mutants.rule: No clone runs under the registry's lock: NoCopyUnderTheLock.

mutants.name: wg1-token-ignored
mutants.rule: A new with the token of an earlier one answers that workspace and makes no second record: ReservingWithATokenTwiceIsOnce.

mutants.name: wg1-memory-bury-keeps-no-tomb
mutants.rule: A buried record's id is a tomb: Registry.BuryKeepsTheId on memory.Registry.

mutants.name: wg1-journal-tomb-unread
mutants.from: tombs = tombs.Append(work.Tomb{Id: try field(i, fields[3]), Since: since})
mutants.rule: The journal reads a tomb line's id back: Registry.BuryKeepsTheId on journal.Registry, ReplayIsTheMemoryRegistry.

mutants.name: wg1-journal-compact-drops-tombs
mutants.rule: Compaction keeps the tombs made at since or later: Registry.CompactKeepsTheRecords on journal.Registry.

mutants.name: wg1-journal-buried-unread
mutants.from: tombs = tombs.Append(work.Tomb{Id: try field(i, fields[1]), Since: since})
mutants.rule: The journal reads back the tombs a compaction wrote: Registry.CompactKeepsTheRecords on journal.Registry.

mutants.name: wg1-memory-lock-shared
mutants.rule: A held key is not held again by another holder: Lock.HoldExcludes on memory.Lock.

mutants.name: wg1-trash-is-not-removed
mutants.rule: A retried rm -expect of a workspace in the trash answers already: RemovingIsIdempotent.

mutants.name: wg1-rm-no-tree
mutants.rule: rm -tree removes the workspace and every descendant: the rm-tree case.

mutants.name: wg1-tree-parent-first
mutants.from:
out = slices.Concat(out, below(all, w.Path))
			out = out.Append(w)
mutants.to:
out = out.Append(w)
			out = slices.Concat(out, below(all, w.Path))
mutants.rule: rm -tree removes the leaves first, so no workspace leaves the registry under a child: the rm-tree case.

mutants.name: wg1-claim-skips-the-parent
mutants.rule: Claim reads the -on parent again under the lock: a new whose parent an rm took after Look claims nothing (rift#56): ClaimReadsTheParentAgain, SchedulesKeepTheInvariants (the claim's parent is live).

mutants.name: wg1-claim-ignores-the-id
mutants.rule: Claim checks the parent's id, so a parent replaced at the same folder after Look is not the one claimed: ClaimReadsTheParentAgain (replaced).

mutants.name: wg1-begin-says-git
mutants.rule: A new -on whose parent an rm took while it read the parent's branch answers NoWorkspace, not Git's failure: SchedulesKeepTheInvariants (no Begin answers VcsFailed).
